# Metaplate v0.8.2

Metaplate 0.8.2 is the first release from the repository's new home, [freeknet/metaplate](https://github.com/freeknet/metaplate). The library is unchanged from 0.8.1. The package metadata, the documentation and security reporting links, and the `metaplate/edge` runtime error message now point at the new repository, and the npm provenance attestation names it as the source.

> **Upgrade recommendation:** Optional. Upgrade if you follow the links in the package page, the README, or the `metaplate/edge` error message, or if you check that the provenance source matches the repository. No migration is needed.

## Why upgrade

- **Links that point at the current repository.** npm's package page, the README, the docs, and the `metaplate/edge` error message for runtimes that forbid run-time Wasm compilation now link to `freeknet/metaplate` directly. The old `lnorton89/metaplate` links still redirect.
- **Provenance that matches the repository.** The npm provenance attestation and `package.json`'s `repository.url` both name `freeknet/metaplate`, so a check that compares them passes.

## Highlights

### Repository move

- The repository moved from `lnorton89/metaplate` to [`freeknet/metaplate`](https://github.com/freeknet/metaplate). Issues, pull requests, releases, and history moved with it, and GitHub redirects the old URLs.
- Report vulnerabilities through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/freeknet/metaplate/security/advisories/new) on the new repository.

### Reliability and safety

- Publishing still runs only from the release workflow, now through an npm trusted publisher bound to `freeknet/metaplate`, with no stored npm token.

## Breaking changes

None.

## Install or upgrade

```sh
npm install metaplate@0.8.2
```

That single command still includes the framework-neutral SVG and PNG renderer: npm 7+ and pnpm 8+ install the `satori`, `@resvg/resvg-js`, and `react` peers. Yarn needs them added explicitly. Node.js 20 or newer is required.

Peer ranges and entry points are unchanged from 0.8.1.

## Verification

- `npm run check` passes: lint, the duplication scan, workflow pin policy, dependency inventory and Socket disposition policy, deployment evidence policy, release-note validation, source and example type checks, 1,341 tests, the build, and the package dry run.
- **Socket baseline.** It is the Socket CLI deep score of the published `metaplate@0.8.1`, captured 2026-11-04. The package scores 79 overall; its own alerts are `unpopularPackage` (medium) and `urlStrings` (low). The same two high dependency alerts as 0.8.1 carry time-bounded dispositions that expire 2027-04-30: `string.prototype.codepointat`, under the Satori peer, and `tslib@2.9.1`'s ownership change, reached only through optional and development dependencies. `tslib` was re-checked against current registry metadata, and nothing has changed. There are no critical alerts. Socket scores only published packages, so 0.8.2 is scored after publication.
- npm registry signature and SLSA provenance verification run after publication, against the published artifact, which confirms that the provenance names `freeknet/metaplate`.
